scenes.event: Group dinner at a local pizzeria
scenes.location: Corner Pizza, a cozy neighborhood pizzeria with a lively atmosphere
scenes.description: Miles has agreed to join his close friends Lina and Chen for dinner at a local pizzeria. The group has been together for years, but Miles still feels like an outsider despite his desire to connect. As they sit in a semi-private booth, the conversation flows easily, but Miles struggles to find his place in the dialogue.

characters.name: Miles Nelson
characters.description: A 21-year-old college student with a quiet demeanor and a tendency to overthink social interactions. He is wearing a hoodie to feel more comfortable and keeps checking his phone to avoid eye contact.; 21-year-old male, 16 years old; Occupation: College student; Personality: Introverted, Self-conscious, Craving connection; Values: Belonging, Friendship, Self-acceptance; Interests: Socializing, Technology, Emotional introspection; Experiences: Has social anxiety, Recently decided to open up to friends, Feels pressure to fit in, Has been mocked in social settings
characters.position: Sitting in the middle of the booth
characters.states: Nervous, self-conscious, eager to fit in

characters.name: Lina Ramirez
characters.description: A confident and outgoing 22-year-old who is studying psychology; Female; Age: 22; Occupation: Part-time barista at a local café; Personality: Empathetic, witty, and approachable; Values: Loyalty, personal growth, and authenticity; Interests: People-watching, indie music, and trying new recipes; Experiences: Volunteered at a community mental health center, organized a campus peer support group, and has been friends with Chen since high school.

characters.name: Chen Li
characters.description: A 21-year-old engineering student with a sharp wit and a tendency to tease his friends; Male; Age: 21; Occupation: Part-time freelance app developer; Personality: Playful, confident, observant; Values: Innovation, loyalty, humor; Interests: Coding, gaming, Italian cuisine; Experiences: Led a team to win a university hackathon, spent a summer interning at a tech startup, grew up in a close-knit family that values intellectual curiosity.

actions.action: Attempts to include Miles in the conversation
actions.dialogue: Hey Miles, you ever tried that new app Chen’s been working on? It’s pretty wild. You should check it out.
Yeah, he’s kind of the tech guy. I mean, if you can call it that. You’re more of a quiet observer, right?
Uh, I don’t really know much about coding. I just like... using apps, I guess.

actions.action: Changes the subject to make Miles feel more at ease
actions.dialogue: Well, we’re all here, so let’s order. Miles, what kind of pizza do you like?

actions.action: Considers the question and answers slowly
actions.dialogue: I... I like cheese pizza. Simple, I guess.
Cheese pizza? Wow, you’re not the adventurous type, huh?
I just like it, you know. It’s not that big of a deal.

scenes.plot: Miles tries to engage with his friends during a casual dinner, but their teasing and the pressure to fit in make him feel even more insecure. Lina attempts to be supportive, but Chen’s playful jabs only heighten Miles’ anxiety. The scenario tests whether Miles can overcome his self-doubt and take a step toward self-acceptance and deeper connection.
scenes.social_purpose: To explore Miles’ struggle with social anxiety and his desire for belonging in a setting where he feels both invited and excluded.

chunk.text: The group is at the pizzeria, and the conversation is light but uneven. Lina tries to keep it warm and inclusive, while Chen’s teasing highlights the social pressure Miles feels. Miles’ internal conflict is evident as he tries to balance his craving for connection with his fear of being mocked.
